tools.name: match_role
tools.description: Given a job description or a list of requirements, return an evidence-backed fit report: for each requirement, the pages and figures on coreyjames.ai that demonstrate it, plus the gaps. Cites, never asserts.

tools.name: search_portfolio
tools.description: Search the systems, engineering stories, capabilities, ideas, technologies and patent applications. Returns ranked pages with their measured results and links.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: The record for one page by URL: title, result, systems, technologies, stats, lede, quote, evidence.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the portfolio (connector-compatible): returns results with id, title and url. Use fetch with an id for the full document.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one portfolio document by id (the page path from search): id, title, text (the page as Markdown), url, metadata.

tools.name: list_systems
tools.description: The ten systems with one-line results.

tools.name: list_technologies
tools.description: Technologies, optionally by kind (language, discipline, platform, framework, protocol, runtime, datastore, hardware, model).

tools.name: list_patent_applications
tools.description: The provisional patent applications (patent pending), with application numbers.

tools.name: who
tools.description: Who this is: name, the name used on patent filings, role, links and how to make contact.

tools.name: scale
tools.description: The size of the body of work: source lines, commits, languages, systems, stories, ideas, tools, patent applications.

tools.name: contact
tools.description: Send a message to Corey James through the site's contact form, on behalf of the user. Requires the user's own name and email.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_page, search, fetch · Private data: get_page, search, fetch, who, contact · Public sink: contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_page, search, fetch · Private data: get_page, search, fetch, who, contact · Public sink: contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
